items.title: Build cross-account streaming pipelines with the Amazon Kinesis Producer Library and Kinesis Client Library
items.summary: Learn how to build an enterprise-scale cross-account streaming pipeline with Amazon Kinesis Data Streams using the Kinesis Producer Library (KPL) and Kinesis Client Library (KCL) across three separate AWS accounts, with resource-based policies, cross-account IAM, and a shared customer managed AWS KMS key for maximum security isolation.
items.creator: Charishma Makineni
